data.headline: How we work
data.summary: The conventions this blog follows, so the next post matches the last.
data.body:
Posts live in /blog. The friendly URL is the post's identity, so renaming one is a move rather than a re-creation.

The summary is what listings show; write it as a sentence, not as a truncated first paragraph.

data.body: Three sample posts is enough to show the shape and few enough to delete without regret.
